versions.localizedDescription:
- Streams tab split into Followed and Top tabs
- Followed now also lists offline channels, tap one to open its page
- Tap the streamer name in the player to open their channel page
- Categories: Followed and All tabs, with a Follow button on each category

- Pinned message now opens over the chat instead of pushing it down
- Follow button on channel pages (real Twitch follow with a web session)
- Device follows are sorted with your other follows and no longer vanish on refresh
- Welcome tutorial on first launch (replay it from Settings → About)
- New “Features in testing” tab in Settings
- Expanding a pinned message no longer stops chat auto-scroll
- Home can show channels as a list (like Twitch) or a grid
- Follow channels without a Twitch account (saved on this device)
- Home works without logging in: top streams and your device follows
- Bot commands: browse Nightbot, StreamElements, Fossabot and Moobot commands from the chat menu
- Update popup now lists everything new since your version
- React to announcements with an emoji
- Settings: new “Features in testing” section (live notifications, test button)
- Latency badge moved to Player settings, auto chat sync to Chat settings
- About: this project is vibe-coded (built with AI assistants)

## Build automatique initial

- Ajout du lecteur vidéo natif et PiP.
- Ajout de l'onglet Historique.
- Support des chaînes suivies et du Top Streams.
